annotations.title: Internal links: report or one page's link graph

description: The website's internal links from the latest crawl: per page links in and out, issues (broken, redirecting, noindex or nofollow targets, generic or off-topic words, the same words for two pages), click depth and suggested links; or one page's link graph. Coverage says how much of the site the crawl read; depth and orphans are judged only when it read all. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.

page.description: One page: its links in and out with their words, issues and suggested links.

path_prefix.description: Only pages under this path in the report.
